concerns.text: Task T005 runs the baseline verifier with `device="cuda"` (GPU off‑load), but the implementation plan (plan.md) explicitly requires the baseline verifier to run **CPU‑only 8‑bit quantized inference** (no GPU escape hatch). This silently relaxes the runtime and hardware constraints (FR‑003, FR‑008) and constitutes a weakening of the plan.

Task T006 re‑uses the same model as T005 for the graph‑augmented verifier but does not specify a CPU‑only mode; given the plan’s restriction that all verifier runs be CPU‑only 8‑bit, the implicit GPU usage again weakens the hardware constraint and may breach FR‑008.

Task T007 states “reuse `code/src/verifier/baseline.py` (GPU‑offloaded) on all 1 000 prompts”, directly contradicting the plan’s mandate that the baseline verifier be CPU‑only 8‑bit quantized. This violates the same constraint as T005.
